objectives: Students in this course will develop and enhance their self-directed research in the arts.
Through engaged studio practice, students will identify and articulate interdisciplinary topics and themes within their work.
Students will identify and become familiar with related work in the field and will articulate correlations and developments to their own research.

Students will investigate a range of materials and methods to build an understanding of the significance of their chosen materials and methods, and demonstrate enhanced proficiency in their chosen research directions.

Students will host periodic studio visits with faculty in which they will demonstrate their understanding of their creative process by presenting and defending their work both orally and through written statements.
